$ edit testdata/script/twice.txtar  # shout now prints SEVEN
$ go test  # echo-shout
    script/twice: A1 is twice B1, which both columns print.
        shout: Does what the case's shout/ tree says.
        out/shout/values.txt differs (-golden +got):
        - A1 SIX
        + A1 SEVEN
        If the change is intended, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... and read the diff before committing.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/frozen
